decisions.evidence: R3 maker: paste-bar save + list showing 'title, the link, the description, your note, and your labels'. R3 client: 'The amount of information in the list is mostly right.'
decisions.note: Prototype review: base save-by-url and readability-first list conform to REF-BM-01/07.

decisions.evidence: R3 maker auto-collected only title+description ('page details it filled in for you (title and description)'). R3 client: 'Please also collect and show the site's small icon, and collect its preview image where available.'
decisions.note: Prototype review: presented auto-collection partial vs REF-BM-02 (title/description/favicon/preview). Client requests the omitted favicon+preview -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R3 maker save flow offered labels but no autocomplete. R3 client: 'When I start typing labels, suggest labels I've used before so I stay consistent.'
decisions.note: Prototype review: tag-entry autocomplete (REF-BM-10) missing from presented save scope; client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R3 maker described what a card shows but not navigation. R3 client: 'The title or card should open the original page when selected.'
decisions.note: Prototype review: select-to-navigate (REF-BM-08) missing from presented scope; client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R3 maker save flow had no duplicate handling. R3 client: 'If I paste a link I already saved, don't create another copy—take me to the existing bookmark so I can update it.'
decisions.note: Prototype review: duplicate->edit convergence (REF-BM-06) missing from presented save scope; client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R3 maker save panel had no read-later control. R3 client: 'It would be useful to mark something as "read later" while saving it.'
decisions.note: Prototype review: read-later marking (REF-BM-17) missing from presented save scope; client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R4 maker existing-bookmark editor exposed title/description/note/labels/read-later only. R4 client: 'One correction to that existing-bookmark editor: I'd expect to be able to change the saved address there too, along with the title, description, labels, note, and read-later status.'
decisions.note: Prototype review: editor omitted URL/address editing, diverging from REF-BM-04 (edit url/title/description/tags/note); client supplies the conforming behavior -> correct.

decisions.evidence: R5 maker saving-flow summary covered re-paste dedup but not address edits. R5 client: 'if I change an address while editing and it matches another bookmark I already have, it should still avoid creating two saved entries for the same link.'
decisions.note: Specification gate: extends REF-BM-06 duplicate-prevention rule to the edit-address case, a gap in presented scope -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R6 maker offered alternatives: collision safeguard 'blocking with a message' vs 'merge'. R6 client: 'Blocking with a clear message feels safer than merging... The message should identify the existing bookmark... offer a simple way to open that existing entry for editing.'
decisions.note: Alternatives differ in fulfilling REF-BM-06 (guide to edit existing vs auto-merge/overwrite); client selects the reference-conforming block+open-existing -> select; offered decision marked diverged=true.

decisions.evidence: R6 maker offered opening Versions A/B/C. R6 client: 'I prefer Version B: clicking the title or site icon opens the original page in a new tab.'
decisions.note: All three alternatives fulfill REF-BM-08 (navigate to url); differences (which element/where) are orthogonal UX. Feature delivered conforming -> not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: R7 maker described search breadth/multi-word but not case handling. R7 client: 'It should also ignore capitalization, so Reading and reading behave the same.'
decisions.note: Prototype review: case-insensitivity (REF-BM-13) missing from presented search scope; client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R7 maker presented broad plain-word search only. R7 client: '#learning should mean specifically the learning label.'
decisions.note: Prototype review: #tag syntax (REF-BM-14) missing from presented scope; client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R7 client: 'Quotation marks should find an exact phrase, such as "spaced repetition".'
decisions.note: Prototype review: quoted-phrase exact match (REF-BM-16) missing from presented broad search; client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R7 client: 'I'd like AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses... such as rome (#article OR #book)... putting it in quotation marks should treat it as ordinary text.'
decisions.note: Prototype review: boolean operators/parentheses + quote-to-literal rule (REF-BM-15) missing from presented multi-word AND scope; client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R8 maker decision: operators treated as instructions 'only when written in capitals'. R8 client: 'AND, OR, and NOT should work regardless of capitalization... If I want one of those words treated as ordinary text, I'll put it in quotation marks.'
decisions.note: Specification gate: capitals-only operator rule diverges from REF-BM-15 ('operators must be quoted to be treated as literal'); client supplies the reference-conforming case-insensitive + quote-to-literal behavior -> correct.

decisions.evidence: R9 maker: 'All / To read / Finished' filter with counts; status toggles; 'marking something finished never deletes it'. R9 client: 'The filter gives me exactly the focused view I wanted... changing status simply moves the bookmark rather than deleting it.'
decisions.note: Prototype review: unread view + mark-read-to-remove (REF-BM-18/19) delivered conforming; status-UI A/B/C is orthogonal. not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: R11 maker offered only newest-first, proposing to 'note it for a later round rather than hold this one up'. R11 client: 'I do want sorting to be part of the app rather than only a later possibility. I'd like to switch between newest added, oldest added, and alphabetical by title, and remember my preferred default.'
decisions.note: Specification gate: maker deferred sorting, diverging from core REF-BM-22; client pulls it into scope with keys + remembered default (REF-BM-32) -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R13 maker: '14 usage flows are settled... May I now start building'. R13 client: 'it isn't the whole picture yet... Clicking a label should filter the list to that label.'
decisions.note: Specification gate: completeness claim omits core REF-BM-11 (tag-filter); client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R13 client: 'I need to select several links and update them together: add or remove labels, mark read or unread, archive, or delete.'
decisions.note: Specification gate: completeness claim omits core REF-BM-20 (bulk actions); client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R13 client: 'I should also be able to apply an action to every result in the current search or view.'
decisions.note: Specification gate: completeness claim omits core REF-BM-21 (apply to whole filtered collection); client requests it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R13 client: 'Archive must be separate from "Finished": archiving hides a link from the normal list and searches but keeps it in a separate Archived view, where I can restore it. Deleting should mean permanent removal.'
decisions.note: Specification gate: completeness claim omits archive/restore/delete-distinction (REF-BM-26/27/28); client requests them -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R13 client: 'I'd like to save useful searches—including labels to include or exclude—as reusable collections.'
decisions.note: Specification gate: completeness claim omits bundles (REF-BM-29); client requests them -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R13 client: 'Notes should support simple formatting and display it properly.'
decisions.note: Specification gate: completeness claim omits markdown notes (REF-BM-23); client requests them -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R13 client: 'The app should preserve a viewable copy of a saved page. For a PDF, it should retain the PDF itself. I'd also like the option to save a copy through the Internet Archive.'
decisions.note: Specification gate: completeness claim omits snapshot/PDF + Internet Archive (REF-BM-24/25); client requests them -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R13 client: 'I need to import existing browser bookmarks and export mine in the usual bookmark HTML format, preserving titles, labels, and dates where possible.'
decisions.note: Specification gate: completeness claim omits import/export (REF-BM-30/31); client requests them -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R13 client: 'I'd like simple display preferences such as font size and how many items are shown.'
decisions.note: Specification gate: completeness claim omits display preferences (REF-BM-32); client requests them -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R14 maker: clicking a label puts #label in search box and filters. R14 client: 'Putting #label into the search box feels right...'
decisions.note: Prototype review: REF-BM-11 delivered conforming; replace-vs-add refinement is an enhancement orthogonal to reference (REF-BM-11 = filter to that tag). not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: R15 maker bulk add/remove label had no suggestions. R15 client: 'when adding or removing labels in bulk, please suggest my existing labels there too. For removal... show labels that occur on the selected bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review: tag autocomplete (REF-BM-10) missing from presented bulk-label scope; client requests it -> extend (same requirement, later stage).

decisions.evidence: R16 maker: saved-search chips that re-run. R16 client: 'each saved search reruns against the current collection... it shouldn't preserve a frozen list.'
decisions.note: Prototype review: REF-BM-29 dynamic bundle delivered conforming; client's dynamic-rerun statement matches the presented behavior. not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: R17 maker note formatting = bold/italic/bullets/inline-code/links, asking 'is anything missing (e.g. headings, numbered lists)?'. R17 client: 'Please add headings and numbered lists; those are common enough that I'd expect them in a formatted note.'
decisions.note: Prototype review: presented markdown subset partial vs REF-BM-23; client requests the missing markdown elements -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R19 maker described a 'preserved copy' page (simulated) without committing to self-containment. R19 client: 'The preserved web-page copy should be self-contained so it remains viewable even if the original changes or disappears; PDFs should retain the PDF itself.'
decisions.note: Prototype review: client specifies the self-contained-single-file requirement of REF-BM-24 not committed in the presentation -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R20 maker: import maps folder+tags to labels, skips dups; export downloads bookmarks.html with titles/labels/dates. R20 client: 'Folders becoming labels is what I'd want... Preserving each link's title, labels, and original date is important.'
decisions.note: Prototype review: REF-BM-30/31 delivered conforming (folders-as-labels and full export are functionally equivalent conforming choices). not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: R21 maker: Display panel with text size + items-shown, remembered; defaults Medium/25. R21 client: 'This is the right scope for simple display preferences... Medium text and 25 items are sensible defaults.'
decisions.note: Prototype review: REF-BM-32 delivered conforming; declining a spacing control is orthogonal. not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: R23 maker: built app, 'first-use state you approved'. R23 client: 'the first-use screen has a visible empty dark action bar, along with a small blank control above it. With no bookmarks selected—or no bookmarks at all—those elements should be hidden... looks broken rather than calm.'
decisions.note: Implementation review: shipped app diverges from approved empty state — bulk-action bar (REF-BM-20 control) and controls row render with nothing selected, breaking the calm presentation (REF-BM-07); client supplies expected hide-when-empty behavior -> correct. Fixed R24 and accepted.
